verdict.rationale: Reflect documents official Chrome and Safari extensions for bookmarking websites and capturing snippets from across the web. The link and the user's highlights are added automatically to the daily note, which covers the core clip-and-highlight capture flow. Missing for 10: documented full-page or full-article content clipping (beyond bookmark links and highlighted snippets), detail on where clips go other than the daily note, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the extensions.
